spec.title: Use cases for base journey J-EXPECTED-FACILITY
spec.status: Basic validation set. Will be filled out further before MVP release.
spec.scope: Selection, the journey with no extra facts, the employed fact, the four covered states, and two steps.
spec.expected_values: Produced by running journeys/tools/resolve.py from cairn-core main on 2026-10-06. Regenerate if the templates change.
changelog_v1_1: Kept to basic cases. Removed walkthrough detail, findings, and uncovered-state cases.
State coverage limited to NH, FL, CA, and NY.
Employment question asked once: a no sets both was_employed and had_employer_plan to false.
Hospice call removed. Step use case is now Tell close family and friends, which is already W0 step 2.

use_cases.title: The case gets this journey
acceptance_criteria: The case stores the journey id and version.
use_cases.test_how: Run journeys/tools/resolve.py (or the app's port of it) on the fixture and compare to expected. journeys/tools/validate.py must report 0 errors first.

use_cases.title: Run the journey with no extra facts

questions_queued: Did your loved one ever serve in the military?
Was your loved one working, or did they have a pension or retirement plan from a job?
Did they set up a living trust?
Did they own a car or other vehicle?
Did they own a home or any land?

main_flow: Show the steps one phase at a time, starting at W0.
For each step, show acknowledge, summary, the one question, and offer_next.
The user marks each step done, not needed, or handled elsewhere, or leaves it open.
Ask queued questions one at a time, when the phase they affect is near.
acceptance_criteria: Steps, order, and counts match expected.
Marking a step changes only that step.
Every step view has Take a break and Support resources.
use_cases.test_how: Run journeys/tools/resolve.py (or the app's port of it) on the fixture and compare to expected. journeys/tools/validate.py must report 0 errors first.

use_cases.title: Add a fact: the person who died was employed
main_flow: When W4 is near, Cairn asks once: "Was your loved one working, or did they have a pension or retirement plan from a job?"
Yes: set was_employed true. No: set was_employed false and had_employer_plan false. Skip or I'm not sure: set nothing.
Resolve again and add or keep steps without changing progress on any other step.
acceptance_criteria: The employment question is asked once per case. After a yes or a no it is never queued again.
A skipped question is not asked again in the same session.
A yes adds S-W4-EMPLOYER and one more certified copy to the estimate.
use_cases.build_note: One answer covers both facts, because the question asks about working and a past employer plan together. The answer handler must set both facts on a no, so M-EMPLOYED resolves to false and is not queued again.
use_cases.test_how: Run journeys/tools/resolve.py (or the app's port of it) on the fixture and compare to expected. journeys/tools/validate.py must report 0 errors first.

use_cases.title: State coverage
use_cases.description: Covers the four states with researched content: NH, FL, CA, NY. Death certificates follow the state where the death happened. Probate follows the state where the person lived.
use_cases.fixture: fixture_base with death_state and residence_state set to each state
acceptance_criteria: Each state's content shows with its citations.
Where an overlay status is not_verified, Cairn says it has no verified steps for that state.
All four overlays are legal review pending, so state content reaches real users only after the attorney review (Trello card 23).
use_cases.test_how: Run journeys/tools/resolve.py (or the app's port of it) on the fixture and compare to expected. journeys/tools/validate.py must report 0 errors first.

use_cases.title: Step: Order certified copies of the death certificate

expected.copy_ask: Would you like me to estimate how many copies you need from the accounts you know about so far?

main_flow: Show the step and its one question.
On yes, show the copy estimate and the state ordering details with citations.
The user marks the copies ordered.
acceptance_criteria: No fee, phone number, or form number appears without its citation.
Estimate = steps needing a certified copy, plus 2.
use_cases.test_how: Run journeys/tools/resolve.py (or the app's port of it) on the fixture and compare to expected. journeys/tools/validate.py must report 0 errors first.

use_cases.title: Step: Tell close family and friends

expected.copy_ask: Is there one person you trust who could make some of these calls for you?

main_flow: Show the step after talking with facility staff.
Offer to help make a short list of who needs to hear directly.
acceptance_criteria: Never asks for names, phone numbers, or contact details to be stored.
The user can mark it done or handled elsewhere.
use_cases.test_how: Run journeys/tools/resolve.py (or the app's port of it) on the fixture and compare to expected. journeys/tools/validate.py must report 0 errors first.

change_needed_in_cairn_core: Set had_employer_plan false along with was_employed false when the user answers no to the M-EMPLOYED question (UC-JEF-03).
